sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Medium-sized to rather large species, very closely related to M. pelatus and M. ocellaris. It differs from M. ocellaris as follows: head, compound eyes and ocelli smaller; pronotum narrower and differently shaped (compare Figs. 320, 307, 321); distal antennal segments shorter; head, thorax and abdomen covered with very short hairs. Postclypeus half as long as wide (0.25 × 0.50). Ocelli large, broadly oval. Antennae 15-segmented; segments 2, 3 and 4 variable, usually equal in length; sometimes segment 2 or segments 2 and 3 shortest. Mandibles as in M. kalgoorliensis. Radial vein absent or nearly so; media running in the anterior third of the wing, unbranched; cubitus very close to the media, running through the middle of the wing, with 9 branches, of which 2—3 are often forked. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 10.70—10.75; body length without wings 5.50—6.00; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.17; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.62; head width 1.13; greatest diameter of compound eye 0.36; ocellus length 0.18; pronotum length 0.65; pronotum width 1.06; forewing length 8.25; forewing width 2.50.

note: Adapted from the new-species description in Hill (1942), originally in English. Distribution: Cunnamulla, Queensland. Described from only a few alates (collected at light indoors on 12 December and 17 December), the holotype in C.S.I.R.; soldier and worker not recorded. Measurements in mm. OCR problems: the original measurement "pronotum, 1.06" omits the word wide, and the annotation pronotum width has been supplied from the style of the neighbouring entries; "M, coellaris" is a misreading of "M. ocellaris".
